tool_args.rationale: The paid observations remain consistent with multiple smooth basin-plus-leak mechanisms. Additional independent rows are needed to distinguish their quantitative branch dependence before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled hydraulic basin model with an external-leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The nine rows show a strong sink-gradient effect but do not uniquely identify the branch or its interaction with the gradient; fitting a flexible branch now risks overfitting.
One open-branch observation has already been acquired, while the trajectory batch supplies more independent observations for fitting the competing branch forms.
The observations already match the target horizon, so longer-horizon discrimination is less relevant.
The nuisance reading does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
